pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.8
pack.summary: Release V2.4.8. 6 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Fixes a bug where the "Install updates automatically" setting on the Settings screen was saved but never actually used — turning it on didn't change anything, and clicking Update by hand was still required every time. Automatic mode now really applies a pack update on its own once it's turned on and a pack folder is set (a launcher self-update still always has to be downloaded and installed by hand, the same as before). Also reworks the whole interface's look toward a lighter, glassier style — softer, more transparent cards and rounder buttons — with no changes to how updating, Play, or Settings actually work.
